approach: Root cause: in `producer_loop` (crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs) the per-criterion self-check result is written to the attempt's invocation `detail` only inside the send-back path (producer.rs:616-625, after the early `break Some(report)` at 545-556). A check that finds every criterion met, or met-or-left-to-Athena, stores nothing, so a job later rejected on an unmet criterion shows no check before the verdict. The path that exhausts the send-back does store its problems, but not per-criterion status. Fix at that one place: add `criteria_check_lines` in send_back.rs. It derives each accepted criterion's status (met, unmet, not reported, or left to Athena's checks) from the existing `unmet_criteria` and `left_to_athena`, so status cannot drift from the send-back decision, and takes the evidence from the already-redacted report. In producer.rs, build that block once per attempt after redaction. Set it as the invocation detail on the passing break, as `self-check passed: criteria: ...`. On the failing path insert it into the existing `self-check failed: {problems}; ...; redacted report: {json}` string, after the problems and before `; redacted report: `, so the existing wording and the `split("redacted report: ")` parse in run_pin_tests.rs:1799 hold. No refusal rule, no new loop, no prompt edit, no schema change (`detail` exists). briefs.rs is not needed, because the producer already gets every criterion and a send-back (briefs.rs:871), so it is not modified.

decisions.choice: Store the criteria block on every attempt's invocation detail, in the same place and field the failing path already uses.
decisions.reason: The failing path already puts its record in `detail` (producer.rs:621); the gap is that the passing path stores nothing. One field, no schema or record-shape change, and every reader of stored invocations sees it.

rejected.option: Add a new field to the invocation record or a new record type.
rejected.why: Changes the schema, check_record_file, the round-trip tests and the gate; `detail` already exists and holds the failing check.

rejected.option: Add a harness gate that blocks the producer's final report without a per-criterion table (the introspections' proposal).
rejected.why: A refusal rule that gives the producer no information it lacks: the brief already lists every criterion and sends the producer back for unmet ones. It would also need a replay share, and the brief asks to prefer information over refusal.

rejected.option: A second repair loop or changing PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS.
rejected.why: Out of scope in the brief.

decisions.choice: Derive each criterion's status in send_back.rs from `unmet_criteria` and `left_to_athena`, not from a second matching rule.
decisions.reason: One definition of met, unmet and left-to-Athena (criterion_key matching, send_back.rs:361) means the stored status always equals the decision that sent the producer back.

rejected.why: Two copies of the matching rule could disagree.

decisions.choice: Put the block before `; redacted report: ` on the failing path and keep the `self-check failed: ` prefix and problem text unchanged.
decisions.reason: Tests assert `detail.contains("self-check failed: check probe failed before the verifier")` (tests.rs:4894), `"self-check failed: records criterion 2:"` (tests.rs:5730), and parse the JSON after `redacted report: ` (run_pin_tests.rs:1799).

rejected.option: Append the block after the JSON.
rejected.why: Breaks the `serde_json::from_str` of everything after `redacted report: ` in run_pin_tests.rs:1799-1800.

decisions.choice: Take the evidence text from the redacted `ProducerReport`, not the raw output.
decisions.reason: Evidence text can hold secrets; `redact_report` (run/mod.rs:2594) runs before anything is stored and the failing path already stores only the redacted report.

rejected.why: Unredacted text would reach stored records.

files.purpose: Add `pub(crate) fn criteria_check_lines(report: &ProducerReport, accepted: &AcceptedReading, unmet: &[String], left: &[String]) -> String`. It returns one line per accepted criterion in `; `-joined form, with status `met`, `unmet (not reported)` or `unmet (<reported status>)`, or `left to Athena's checks`, plus the redacted evidence, found by `criterion_key` (send_back.rs:361). Add unit tests there for the three statuses.

After `redact_report`, build the criteria block once. Set the attempt invocation's detail to `self-check passed: criteria: ...` before `break Some(report)` (the empty-problems branch). In the send-back block, insert the block between the problems and `; redacted report: `. Add a Root-cause paragraph to the producer_loop doc comment. Both branches write through `closing.new_invocations.last_mut()`.
Add the two whole-job tests (met report; omitted criterion with the send-back used up).
One new bullet under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Changed`: root cause, fix location, no refusal rule (0% newly refused), tests.

steps: In send_back.rs add `criteria_check_lines(report: &athena_data::records::ProducerReport, accepted: &AcceptedReading, unmet: &[String], left: &[String]) -> String`. For each `(text, _)` in `accepted.criteria`: find the report entry whose `criterion_key` equals the criterion's key. Status is `left to Athena's checks` if the text is in `left` and not in `unmet`; `unmet (not reported)` if it is in `unmet` and has no entry; `unmet (<entry status>)` if it is in `unmet` with an entry; else `met`. Format each as `"<text>" -> <status>[: <evidence>]` and join with `; `. Unit tests: all met, one omitted, one unmet with evidence, one left to Athena.

In producer.rs, after `let report = self.redact_report(raw, ctx.redactor)?;` (about line 512), compute `let criteria_block = criteria_check_lines(&report, accepted, &unmet, &left_criteria);` and add `changed.len()` as `checked against N changed files`.

In the empty-problems branch (`if unmet.is_empty() && ... { break Some(report); }`) set the last invocation's detail before the break: `format!("self-check passed: criteria: {criteria_block}")`, through `closing.new_invocations.last_mut().expect(...)`, the same call used at the send-back block.
In the send-back block change the detail format to `self-check failed: {problems}; criteria: {criteria_block}; redacted report: {json}`. Keep the prefix and the problems text unchanged.
Add a Root-cause paragraph to the `producer_loop` doc comment (the nature of the gap: the outcome was stored only when it failed, so a pass left no stored event before the final verdict).

In tests.rs add `a_passing_self_check_is_stored_on_the_producers_invocation` (criterion 3) and `a_criterion_the_report_omits_is_stored_unmet_after_the_send_back_is_used` (criterion 4), following the Records::load pattern at tests.rs:4885-4892. Check the producer invocation count, the status text, and in the second test that the JSON after `redacted report: ` still parses.

Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Changed`: root cause, the fix at producer_loop plus `criteria_check_lines`, 'no refusal rule is added (0% of past accepted readings newly refused)', tests, and the limit that the block shows the producer's reported evidence, not an Athena re-run.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; fix failures.

risks.risk: A longer stored detail on passing attempts enlarges invocation records and could be read by a place that assumed a passing producer has no detail.
risks.mitigation: The block holds one short line per criterion; I searched `.detail` readers (producer.rs:408/420, auditor, hestia, pin, audience, steward, lifecycle, retry tests) and found none that read a successful producer's detail. The full `cargo test --locked` gate runs the CLI lifecycle and drain tests.

risks.risk: Evidence text in the block could carry unredacted secrets.
risks.mitigation: Evidence is taken from the redacted `ProducerReport` (redact_report, run/mod.rs:2594), the same text the failing path already stores.

risks.risk: The fake agent in other tests (athena-agent fake.rs:329) builds criteria_check from the brief, so many jobs now store a detail that earlier asserts on `None` or exact text might reject.
risks.mitigation: I searched for `detail.is_none()` and `detail, None` asserts on a stored producer record and found only record constructions, not assertions on a stored producer detail; the full gate runs them all.

risks.risk: Hand-kept-file mirror checks (crates/athena-core/src/mirrors.rs) apply to Athena's own source when producer.rs or the CHANGELOG change.
risks.mitigation: The CHANGELOG bullet follows the existing form; no decision log, prompt or CI file is touched, so the registry entries (decision log, shard timings, ontology) are not affected.

demonstrations.method: New test `run::tests::a_passing_self_check_is_stored_on_the_producers_invocation` in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs. It uses `athena(&repo,&state)` (tests.rs:180), which runs `base_script()` (tests.rs:225): the producer edits README.md and marks CRITERION `met`, and the verifier passes. It then calls `athena.ask` and `athena.go(.., AcceptedBy::User, &Quiet)` (the entry point other tests use, e.g. tests.rs:4849-4863), loads `Records::load(&athena.git, &athena.head().unwrap())` and reads the Producer invocation's `detail`, as at tests.rs:4885-4892.
demonstrations.observes: There is exactly one producer invocation (no send-back); its detail starts with `self-check passed`, contains `README.md describes the demo` with status `met`, and the evidence `read it`. The test also asserts the job reached a verifier, i.e. the check ran before the verdict.
